name: Solano County Health and Social Services
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Solano County residents.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Solano County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- Adult and aging services, including IHSS
howToGetIt:
Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call the toll-free line.

Offices: 275 Beck Ave, Fairfield · 1119 E. Monte Vista Ave, Vacaville · plus a Vallejo office.
keywords: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, food stamps, CalWORKs, benefits office, apply, Solano County, Fairfield, Vacaville, Vallejo, health and social services
